H3BuildShotPrompt.description: Turn one storyboard shot into a structured H3 prompt.

subject.name: Subject and continuity
subject.tooltip: Who or what must remain recognizable across the shot.

action_timeline.name: Action timeline
action_timeline.tooltip: Describe visible actions in time order, for example 0–2s and 2–5s.

environment.name: Environment and physical interaction
environment.tooltip: Location, weather, water, props, contact, and other physical details.

camera.name: Camera and framing
camera.tooltip: Shot size, camera movement, angle, and whether cuts are allowed.

look_and_sound.name: Look, lighting, and sound
look_and_sound.tooltip: Visual realism, light, mood, dialogue, and ambient sound.

avoid.name: Avoid
avoid.tooltip: Identity, anatomy, motion, text, or editing failures to avoid.

0.name: Shot prompt
0.tooltip: Connect this to Prompt on H3 Generate Video.

H3EmptyReferences.description: Start an ordered Ref2VA reference list. Order changes the result.

H3AddImageReference.description: Append one image to the ordered Ref2VA reference list.

references.name: Existing references
references.tooltip: References already added; their order is preserved.

image.name: Image
image.tooltip: The next subject, identity, style, or environment reference.

0.name: References
0.tooltip: The list with this image appended.

H3AddAudioReference.description: Append one audio clip to the ordered Ref2VA reference list.

references.name: Existing references
references.tooltip: References already added; their order is preserved.

audio.name: Audio
audio.tooltip: The next voice, music, or environmental-audio reference.

0.name: References
0.tooltip: The list with this audio clip appended.

H3AddMediaFileReference.description: Append a local image, video, or audio file in a precise order.

references.name: Existing references
references.tooltip: References already added; their order is preserved.

kind.name: Media type
kind.tooltip: Choose how h3.c should interpret the local file.

path.name: Media file path
path.tooltip: Absolute path to the local image, audio, or video.

audio_path.name: Separate audio path (optional)
audio_path.tooltip: Required only for video_audio with a separate sound file.

0.name: References
0.tooltip: The list with this media reference appended.

H3GenerateVideo.description: Generate an MP4 through h3.c Metal inference on Apple Silicon.

prompt.name: Prompt
prompt.tooltip: Describe identity, actions over time, environment, camera, look, sound, and unwanted failures.

references.name: References
references.tooltip: Ordered Ref2VA materials. Do not combine these with first/last frames.

first_frame.name: First frame (optional)
first_frame.tooltip: FL2VA opening-frame anchor. Leave references empty when using it.

last_frame.name: Last frame (optional)
last_frame.tooltip: FL2VA closing-frame anchor. Leave references empty when using it.

task.name: Model task
task.tooltip: Use Ref2VA for ordered references, or FL2VA for text/first/last frame generation.

width.name: Width
width.tooltip: Output width; must be a multiple of 16.

height.name: Height
height.tooltip: Output height; must be a multiple of 16.

seconds.name: Duration (seconds)
seconds.tooltip: Duration of this shot at 24 FPS.

quality_profile.name: Quality profile
quality_profile.tooltip: Preview is fastest; quality is the normal final; reference is a slow diagnostic oracle.

resource_profile.name: Resource profile
resource_profile.tooltip: Low and auto are foreground-friendly; max is for an idle Mac.

seed.name: Seed
seed.tooltip: Keep the same seed while refining a shot for more comparable results.

reuse_completed.name: Reuse identical completed job
reuse_completed.tooltip: Return a matching completed shot instead of generating it again.

1.name: Job directory
1.tooltip: Connect this to a numbered input on Assemble Storyboard MP4.

2.name: Run summary
2.tooltip: Job ID, elapsed time, profile, and output path.

H3AssembleStoryboard.description: Join 2–6 completed H3 shots in order without another generation pass.

shot_1_job.name: Shot 1 job directory
shot_1_job.tooltip: Connect Job directory from the first H3 Generate Video node.

shot_2_job.name: Shot 2 job directory
shot_2_job.tooltip: Connect Job directory from the second H3 Generate Video node.

0.name: Final video
0.tooltip: The assembled MP4 with hard cuts between shots.

1.name: Storyboard directory
1.tooltip: Contains metadata, FFmpeg log, and the final MP4.

2.name: Assembly summary
2.tooltip: Storyboard ID, reuse state, and output path.
